title: 3-day moving average temperature
prompt: Return day, temperature, and a 3-day moving average (current row and the 2 preceding rows) named moving_avg, ordered by day.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE temps (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, day INTEGER, temperature REAL); INSERT INTO temps VALUES (1,1,60.0),(2,2,65.0),(3,3,70.0),(4,4,68.0),(5,5,72.0);
reference_sql: SELECT day, temperature, AVG(temperature) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM temps;
